title: GuardAction
description: A denial-handling outcome attached to a NavigationGuard that specifies what the router does when the guard's condition fails. It either redirects to a route or URL, cancels navigation in place, shows a message, or asks for confirmation, and it records whether the attempted route is kept so the user can return to it later. Use NavigationGuard instead when you are modelling the interceptor itself: its mechanism type (auth, role, feature-flag), its execution order, and the routes it protects, rather than what happens on denial. Use GuardCondition instead when you are modelling the boolean predicate the guard evaluates (e.g. 'user.isAuthenticated'), not the response executed when that predicate is false. Use NavigationTransition instead when you are modelling a standing edge between two routes in the navigation graph (including one with trigger 'redirect') rather than a guard's conditional denial response. Use Route instead when the redirect is unconditional, such as a route of type 'redirect' whose router entry always forwards (e.g. { path: '/', redirectTo: '/home' }) regardless of any access check.

action.description: The action taken when the guard denies access to the target route.

target.description: Destination for redirect or replace actions — a Route ID (e.g., 'login') or an absolute URL. Ignored for block and notify actions.

message.description: User-facing message shown when action is 'notify' or 'prompt', explaining why access was denied.

preserveRoute.description: When true, the originally attempted route is stored (e.g., in session state) so the user can be redirected back to it after successfully authenticating.

x-dr-standard: SPA Navigation Patterns: navigation guard outcome (redirect or cancel), e.g. Angular CanActivate/CanDeactivate returning a UrlTree or false, and Vue Router beforeEach returning a route location or false
x-dr-evidence: The denied branch of a beforeEach/canActivate guard that returns a redirect location carrying the attempted path, e.g. return { name: 'login', query: { redirect: to.fullPath } } or router.createUrlTree(['/login'], { queryParams: { returnUrl: state.url } }).
A guard branch that aborts navigation with next(false), return false, or event.preventDefault(), optionally preceded by a toast or notification call explaining the denial.
A window.confirm(...) or modal-dialog prompt inside a canDeactivate or beforeRouteLeave hook, or a React protected-route wrapper rendering <Navigate to="/login" state={{ from: location }} replace />.
